li.label: fuel need
li.description: My internal reactor needs fuel to produce vital energy.

li.label: fuel deficiency
li.description: My internal reactor is running moderately low on fuel.

li.label: fuel deprivation
li.description: I have burnt through a large amount of fuel. My reactor needs to be replenished.

li.label: fuel starvation
li.description: My reactor will last me a few days at most on such a scarce amount of fuel.

li.label: severe fuel starvation
li.description: Systems are shutting down one by one to keep the reactor alight.

li.label: critical fuel starvation
li.description: The reactor is sputtering. I can feel my thoughts slowing down.

li.label: extreme fuel starvation
li.description: ...This is it? I didn't think it'd all end so anticlimactically.
